required_documents.name: SF424 (R&R) Application Package
required_documents.details: Standard institutional cover form for federal assistance.

required_documents.name: Project Summary / Abstract
required_documents.details: Overview of the hands-on research experience program, target participants, and scientific focus (max 30 lines).
required_documents.source: PA-27-036-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Brief public health impact statement describing the benefits of training future scientists.
required_documents.source: PA-27-036-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Facilities & Other Resources
required_documents.details: Institutional research environment, laboratories, core facilities, and equipment available to student participants.
required_documents.source: PA-27-036-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Senior/Key Person Profiles
required_documents.details: Biographical sketches for Program Director(s) and research mentor faculty (max 5 pages each).
required_documents.source: PA-27-036-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 Senior/Key Person Profile

required_documents.name: R&R Detailed Budget and Justification
required_documents.details: Detailed budget for participant support costs (stipends/subsistence, travel) and program administration (F&A limited to 8%).

required_documents.name: Specific Aims
required_documents.details: One page defining the aims of the experiential research program.
required_documents.source: PA-27-036-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Research Education Program Plan - Research Experiences
required_documents.details: Maximum 25 pages uploaded under Research Strategy covering Participant Recruitment, Mentor Matching, Hands-On Projects, and Program Evaluation.
required_documents.source: PA-27-036-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Institutional Commitment Letter
required_documents.details: Signed letter from institutional leadership guaranteeing facilities, mentor participation, and administrative resources.
required_documents.source: PA-27-036-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Plan for Instruction in Responsible Conduct of Research
required_documents.details: Maximum 3 pages detailing bioethics, compliance, and responsible research conduct curricula.
required_documents.source: PA-27-036-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Registrations (SAM.gov, Grants.gov, eRA Commons)
required_documents.details: Active institutional registrations in SAM.gov and Grants.gov; eRA Commons ID for all Program Directors.

deadlines.when: September 25, 2026, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
January 25, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
May 25, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization

eligibility.summary: Higher education institutions, healthcare organizations, biomedical research non-profits, and state/local government entities. In North Carolina, universities and academic health systems with active laboratory research programs are eligible.

cost_share.details: This NOFO does not require cost sharing as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement.

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided each application is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Clinical trials are not permitted under this mechanism.
Program Plan must not exceed 25 pages in the Research Strategy section.
Participants must be provided meaningful full-time or part-time hands-on laboratory or clinical research experiences.
